# pve_notification_endpoint_webhook (Resource)

Manages a webhook notification endpoint (`POST/PUT/DELETE /cluster/notifications/endpoints/webhook/{name}`). Every mutation is synchronous per the pin (no task is spawned).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

resource "pve_notification_endpoint_webhook" "alerting" {
  name   = "alerting-hook"
  url    = "https://hooks.example.com/pve"
  method = "post"
  body   = "{\"text\":\"{{ title }}: {{ message }}\"}"
  headers = {
    "X-Token" = "static-header-value"
  }
  secrets = {
    HMAC = "your-signing-secret"
  }
  comment = "Webhook for the alerting pipeline"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `method` (String) HTTP method used for the request. Must be one of: `post`, `put`, `get`.
- `name` (String) The name of the endpoint (PVE `pve-configid` format). Changing this value forces recreation.
- `url` (String) Server URL to send the request to.

### Optional

- `body` (String) HTTP body template; PVE notification template placeholders such as `{{ title }}` are supported. PVE stores the body base64-encoded; encoding and decoding are transparent. Removed when unset on update.
- `comment` (String) Comment. Removed when unset on update.
- `disable` (Boolean) Disable this target. PVE defaults to `false`.
- `headers` (Map of String) HTTP headers to set, as a `name` to `value` map. PVE stores them as `name=<name>,value=<base64 of value>` property strings; values are encoded and decoded transparently. Removed when unset on update.
- `secrets` (Map of String, Sensitive) Secrets referenced by the body or header templates via `{{ secrets.<name> }}`, as a `name` to `value` map. PVE stores them as `name=<name>,value=<base64 of value>` property strings; values are encoded and decoded transparently. Removed when unset on update.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# Import an existing webhook endpoint by its name:
terraform import pve_notification_endpoint_webhook.alerting alerting-hook
```
